title: Enhancing Cooperation through Selective Interaction and Long-term Experiences in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper explores the emergence of cooperation within a Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework using the Prisoner's Dilemma game. While it discusses 'pro-social' behavior and references prior work on 'moral choices,' its primary focus is on computational game theory and reinforcement learning strategies rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or ethical frameworks.
